answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 10341 Country: Pakistan Title: AOA.. I want to keep my daughter's name as "Raadiyen". Its the name of one of the doors of Jannat through which 'Zakiriyen' will enter. Can I keep this name and is this correct through Shariat? Question: AOA.. I want to keep my daughter's name as "Raadiyen". Its the name of one of the doors of Jannat through which 'Zakiriyen' will enter. Can I keep this name and is this correct through Shariat? Answer ID: 10341 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 120/120=M/1429) We could not find any source to believe that Radheen is the name of a door of Jannah. It is better for you to name your daughter as: Radhiya ( راضیہ ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
